Step 1 - Business Rule Validation
- Duplicate processing:
  - Test Case ID: TC001
  - Requirement ID: REQ001
  - Coverage Area: Duplicate processing
  - Title: System prevents a second payment against an already-paid bill
  - Priority: High
  - Test Type: Business Rule
  - Preconditions: Customer has already successfully paid this bill once
  - Test Data: Same account number and bill reference as the earlier successful payment
  - Steps:
    - Open the bill payment page
    - Enter the same account number used for the earlier payment
    - Attempt to pay the same bill again
    - Submit the payment
  - Expected Result: System blocks the duplicate payment and informs the customer the bill is already paid.
  - Automation Candidate: Yes
  - Source Traceability: Source: business rules

Step 2 - Duplicate Processing Test Case
- Test Case ID: TC002
- Requirement ID: REQ001
- Coverage Area: Duplicate processing
- Title: Bill balance is not updated when a payment is only partially processed
- Priority: High
- Test Type: Business Rule
- Preconditions: A payment attempt is interrupted partway through processing
- Test Data: Valid account number, valid card details, payment interrupted before confirmation
- Steps:
  - Open the bill payment page
  - Enter valid account and card details
  - Submit the payment
  - Interrupt the transaction before confirmation
- Expected Result: The outstanding balance remains unchanged and no partial payment is recorded.
- Automation Candidate: No
- Source Traceability: Source: business rules
